test_fwd_velocity: test the mjw.fwd_velocity function computes actuator velocity and bias forces for humanoid and pendula models
test_fwd_actuation: test the mjw.fwd_actuation function computes actuator forces, torques, and activation dynamics for various actuator types
test_fwd_acceleration: test the mjw.fwd_acceleration function computes smooth forces and accelerations for the humanoid model
test_step1: test the mjw.step1 function updates kinematics, inertia, constraints, and passive forces for forward dynamics
test_step2: test the mjw.step2 function computes actuation, acceleration, and integrates position and velocity for forward dynamics
test_step: test the mjw.step function runs a full simulation step including velocity, actuation, acceleration, and integration
test_forward: test the mjw.forward function runs the complete forward dynamics pipeline for a mujoco model
test_euler: test the mjw.euler function performs Euler integration with sparse and dense Jacobian configurations
test_rungekutta4: test the mjw.rungekutta4 function performs RK4 integration and verifies deterministic results on GPU
test_implicit: test the mjw.implicit function performs implicit integration with velocity, damper, and tendon actuator configurations
test_graph_capture: test the mjw.step function with CUDA graph capture enabled for conditional and unconditional graph modes
test_control_callback: test the m.callback.control kernel is invoked during forward dynamics and skipped when actuation is disabled
test_act_dyn_callback: test the m.callback.act_dyn kernel implements a harmonic oscillator actuator dynamics model
test_dcmotor_stateless_steady_state: test the dcmotor actuator computes steady-state force with stateless gain and bias configurations
test_dcmotor_current_filter: test the dcmotor actuator with integrator dynamics computes current filter derivative correctly
test_dcmotor_cogging_torque: test the dcmotor actuator computes cogging torque from position-dependent bias parameters
test_dcmotor_lugre_viscous_friction: test the dcmotor actuator with Lugre friction model computes viscous friction force correctly
test_dcmotor_thermal_affects_force: test the dcmotor thermal model affects actuator force based on temperature rise above ambient
test_dcmotor_stateful_position_mode: test the dcmotor actuator in stateful position mode with slew rate, integral, and derivative control
test_dcmotor_lugre_exact_integration: test the dcmotor Lugre bristle deflection uses exact analytical integration instead of Euler
test_dcmotor_current_filter_exact_integr: test the dcmotor current filter uses exact exponential integration instead of Euler approximation
test_dcmotor_int_velocity_equivalence: test the intvelocity and dcmotor actuators produce equivalent integrated states under identical velocity commands
test_dcmotor_integral_clamp: test the dcmotor integral state clamps act_dot to zero when integral exceeds Imax bounds
test_dcmotor_voltage_limit: test the dcmotor actuator clamps output voltage to Vmax when control exceeds saturation range
test_dcmotor_lugre_steady_state: test the dcmotor Lugre model reaches steady-state bristle deflection under constant velocity
test_multiflex: test the mjw.forward function handles multiflex models with different flex dimensions
test_step_no_dofs: test the mjw.step function handles models with no degrees of freedom without errors
